sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Two weeks ago, we asked if you, or more specifically your kids, had questions for the Artemis II astronauts.
sentences.zh: 两周前，我们问你们，或者更具体地说是你们的孩子，有没有关于阿耳忒弥斯2号宇航员的问题。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Mateo.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫马特奥。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Ayla Renovar.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是艾拉·雷诺瓦尔。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Benjamin Sousa.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫本杰明·索萨。

sentences.en: My name is Owen.
sentences.zh: 我叫欧文。

sentences.en: I'm three years old.
sentences.zh: 我三岁了。

sentences.en: Kids definitely had questions.
sentences.zh: 孩子们确实有很多问题。

sentences.en: How yummy was that food?
sentences.zh: 那食物有多好吃？

sentences.en: I think they ate stars.
sentences.zh: 我想他们吃的是星星。

sentences.en: The moon made out of cheese.
sentences.zh: 月亮是由奶酪做成的。

sentences.en: How did you get to the moon without using Google Maps?
sentences.zh: 不用谷歌地图，你们是怎么去月球的？

sentences.en: Kids wanted to know about life on board the spaceship, about the wonder and the vastness of space.
sentences.zh: 孩子们想知道飞船上的生活，想知道太空的奇妙与浩瀚。

sentences.en: Were you scared?
sentences.zh: 你们害怕吗？

sentences.en: Because I would be scared.
sentences.zh: 因为我会害怕。

sentences.en: Why did they go on the mission thing when it was super duper duper duper whiskey?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要去执行那个超级无敌极其疯狂的任务？

sentences.en: My question for the Artemis crew is how do you think people will look back at this mission in 50 years?
sentences.zh: 我给阿耳忒弥斯乘组的问题是，你们认为50年后人们会如何回顾这次任务？

sentences.en: And today, we posed these questions to the astronauts themselves.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们把这些问题抛给了宇航员自己。

sentences.en: Read Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen to learn what their mission to the moon was like,
sentences.zh: 请听里德·怀斯曼、维克托·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫和杰里米·汉森讲述他们的登月任务是怎样的，

sentences.en: how it changed their perspective about life here on Earth, and whether it is possible to drink soda in space.
sentences.zh: 这次任务如何改变了他们对地球上生命的看法，以及在太空中是否有可能喝苏打水。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月6日，星期三。

sentences.en: Crew of the Artemis II, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯2号乘组，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Reed, Jeremy, Victor, Christina, you have been answering about a thousand trillion questions since you got back from your mission to the moon.
sentences.zh: 里德、杰里米、维克托、克里斯蒂娜，自从你们完成登月任务回来后，你们一直在回答大约一万亿个问题。

sentences.en: And that makes sense because space captivates us in a way that very few things do.
sentences.zh: 这是情理之中，因为太空以极少数事物能及的方式吸引着我们。

sentences.en: And perhaps no group of people embraces the wonder and curiosity of space better than children.
sentences.zh: 也许没有任何群体能比孩子们更好地拥抱对太空的惊叹与好奇。

sentences.en: And so for that reason, we asked kids to submit questions to the daily and we got so many responses so many more than in my entire time of the daily and amazing
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们邀请孩子们向《每日新闻》提问，我们收到了如此多的回复，比我做《每日新闻》整个职业生涯中见过的还要多，太惊人了。

sentences.en: a lot of kids as you i'm sure you've heard they want to go to space too i'm going to be a grown-up
sentences.zh: 正如你们肯定听说的，很多孩子也想去太空，我要长大，

sentences.en: i'm going to be an astronaut too i'm saving up to go to space camp next summer what does it take
sentences.zh: 我也要成为一名宇航员，我正在存钱准备明年夏天去太空营，需要具备什么条件

sentences.en: to be an astronaut when you were a kid did you guys ever imagine that you would go to the dark side of the moon.
sentences.zh: 才能成为一名宇航员？你们小时候有没有想过自己会去到月球背面？

sentences.en: I want to be an astronaut when I grow up.
sentences.zh: 我长大后想成为一名宇航员。

sentences.en: What is one piece of advice you can give me?
sentences.zh: 你们能给我的一条建议是什么？

sentences.en: What would you tell a child about the qualities that allow you to do what you do, to be astronauts, and how a child might cultivate those?
sentences.zh: 对于那些能让你从事这份工作、成为宇航员的品质，你会对孩子说些什么？孩子们又该如何培养这些品质？

sentences.en: Reid, would you like to start?
sentences.zh: 里德，你想先开始吗？

sentences.en: I think curiosity and the wonder of nature.
sentences.zh: 我认为是好奇心和大自然的奇妙。

sentences.en: I just, you cannot leave out the wonder of nature.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，你绝不能忽视大自然的奇妙。

sentences.en: Walk outside, look at a tree, watch a bird fly, watch water go around rocks as it's coming down a waterfall or a stream, just any way you can look at nature.
sentences.zh: 走到户外，看一棵树，看一只鸟飞翔，看水流过瀑布或小溪中的岩石，只要能以任何方式观察大自然。

sentences.en: Jeremy?
sentences.zh: 杰里米？

sentences.en: Persistence is another one we talk about a lot because the one thing that we can all guarantee kids today, there are going to be challenges between you and your goal.
sentences.zh: 坚持是我们经常讨论的另一个品质，因为我们可以向今天的孩子们保证一件事，在你的目标和梦想之间必然会有挑战。

sentences.en: And there are going to be times where you do not believe you're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 有时你会觉得自己不可能成功。

sentences.en: And you're just going to have to have persistence to keep trying and let other people know where you're trying to go so they can help you.
sentences.zh: 你必须坚持不懈地继续尝试，并让其他人知道你的目标，这样他们才能帮助你。

sentences.en: Victor?
sentences.zh: 维克托？

sentences.en: The number one thing I I would say to a young person, is being a good teammate.
sentences.zh: 我要对年轻人说最重要的一点，就是做一个好的队友。

sentences.en: And the reason I would start with that one is because at the end of the day, you don't get to say if you're a good teammate.
sentences.zh: 我之所以从这一点开始，是因为归根结底，你说了不算自己是不是一个好队友。

sentences.en: It's your teammates who say that.
sentences.zh: 是由你的队友来评判的。

sentences.en: And so focusing on that, they can start practicing that today.
sentences.zh: 因此专注这一点，他们今天就可以开始练习。

sentences.en: Christina?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜？

sentences.en: Rounding it out, there's so many left to choose from.
sentences.zh: 总结一下，还有那么多品质可以选。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about humility.
sentences.zh: 我想到了谦逊。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about hard work.
sentences.zh: 我想到了努力工作。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking about supporting the people around you.
sentences.zh: 我想到了支持身边的人。

sentences.en: Well, those are all very beautiful answers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这些都是非常精彩的回答。

sentences.en: And now I want to actually talk about the mission that you went on.
sentences.zh: 现在我想聊聊你们执行的那次任务。

sentences.en: So this was a historic trip, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一次具有历史意义的旅行。

sentences.en: You were gone for 10 days.
sentences.zh: 你们离开了10天。

sentences.en: You were farther than any human has ever been from Earth.
sentences.zh: 你们到达了人类从未去过的距离地球最远的地方。

sentences.en: You orbited the moon.
sentences.zh: 你们环绕月球飞行。

sentences.en: You went to the far side of the moon.
sentences.zh: 你们去了月球背面。

sentences.en: You lost contact with people back on Earth briefly.
sentences.zh: 你们曾与地球上的人们短暂失联。

sentences.en: And we got a lot of questions about what that felt like.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多关于那种感觉是什么样的问题。

sentences.en: So here is a question from Colin in California.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一个来自加利福尼亚州科林的提问。

sentences.en: My question for the astronauts of OEMS 2 is, how did it feel like to be on the dark side of the moon?
sentences.zh: 我给OEMS 2号宇航员的问题是，身处月球背面是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Was it scary or was it adventurous?
sentences.zh: 是可怕的还是充满冒险的？

sentences.en: Christina, scary or adventurous?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，是可怕还是充满冒险？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I would say in some ways, I would almost call it solemn.
sentences.zh: 我会说在某些方面，我甚至觉得它有点庄严。

sentences.en: We had so much work to do, so we were also very busy.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多工作要做，所以我们也十分忙碌。

sentences.en: But we did know it needed to be commemorated amongst us when we were the four people out there by ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，当我们在那里孤身一人的这四个人之间，需要为此留下纪念。

sentences.en: And we did that.
sentences.zh: 我们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: we took a moment and then we kind of got back to work.
sentences.zh: 我们花了一点时间，然后就投入到工作中去了。

sentences.en: But I can't imagine, Reed, that you're not up there looking at what you're looking at and being at least momentarily distracted from the very important work that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 里德，我无法想象你在那里看着眼前的景象，能不从你正在做的极其重要的工作中分心哪怕片刻。

sentences.en: He laughs.
sentences.zh: 他笑了。

sentences.en: It's funny that he asked me that question.
sentences.zh: 他问我这个问题挺有意思的。

sentences.en: It turned out that Victor's, he didn't know his job before launch would be to always pull me away from the window back into the vehicle, but that did end up being his job.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，维克托在发射前不知道他的工作就是一直把我从窗户边拉回飞船里，但最终这确实成了他的工作。

sentences.en: But when we're on the far side of the moon first uh for us you know the far side of the moon is often lit by the sun
sentences.zh: 但当我们到达月球背面时，首先，对我们来说，你知道，月球背面经常被太阳照亮，

sentences.en: whenever we have a new moon here on earth that means that the far side is fully illuminated and
sentences.zh: 每当我们在地球上看到新月时，就意味着背面被完全照亮了，

sentences.en: it was as we're looking at the far side it was the right side of the moon that was lit up which was
sentences.zh: 当我们看着背面时，被照亮的是月球的右侧，

sentences.en: really special for us because human eyes even though we went to the moon in the 1960s and 70s
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常特别，因为人类的眼睛——尽管我们在20世纪60和70年代

sentences.en: in the magnificent apollo program human eyes had never looked at what we were looking down on
sentences.zh: 通过伟大的阿波罗计划去过月球——人类的眼睛从未看过我们当时俯瞰的景象，

sentences.en: there are a few craters a basin called oriental which is kind of the marquee basin of the solar
sentences.zh: 那里有几个陨石坑，一个叫东方海的盆地，可以说是太阳系中最引人注目的盆地，

sentences.en: system that we were able to look down on craters like vavel off and ohm and ohm's ejector rays
sentences.zh: 我们得以俯瞰它，还有像瓦维洛夫和欧姆这样的陨石坑，欧姆的喷射射线

sentences.en: streak from the far side around to the front side that was really special for us to get to see
sentences.zh: 从背面延伸到正面，能看到这些对我们来说真的很特别，

sentences.en: the thing that i just can't stress enough is we did take a moment but then we had so much science
sentences.zh: 我怎么强调都不为过的是，我们确实花了一点时间，但随后我们要进行大量的科学研究，

sentences.en: that we were trying to conduct we were trying to record everything that the human eye saw on the far side because we never see it here on earth.
sentences.zh: 我们试图记录人类眼睛在背面看到的每一幕，因为我们在地球上永远看不到。

sentences.en: We are gravitationally locked to only see the near side of the moon here.
sentences.zh: 由于引力锁定，我们在这里只能看到月球的正面。

sentences.en: So we did take a moment and then it was right back into the work.
sentences.zh: 所以我们花了一点时间，然后就立刻投入到了工作中。

sentences.en: I haven't found good words to describe it, but you know, how it felt was overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 我找不到好的词来形容它，但你知道，那种感觉是压倒性的。

sentences.en: There was a time when Reed mentioned that our brains have not evolved to see what we're seeing.
sentences.zh: 有一次里德提到，我们的大脑还没有进化到能够看到我们所看到的景象。

sentences.en: And so we were actually, you know, transitioning from the far side to coming back toward the near side when the sun went behind the moon.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，你知道，当我们从背面过渡并返回正面时，太阳落到了月亮后面。

sentences.en: It got really bright and then really dark.
sentences.zh: 先是变得非常耀眼，然后又变得一片漆黑。

sentences.en: And looking out at this really large oar, it was all of the things.
sentences.zh: 看着这个巨大的惊叹，百感交集。

sentences.en: I mean, there were so many different emotions at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当时有那么多不同的情绪同时涌现。

sentences.en: I can't tell you how many times I heard something like, oh my God.
sentences.zh: 我数不清自己听到了多少次诸如“我的天哪”这样的话。

sentences.en: And I think that was not in vain.
sentences.zh: 我想那并不是白喊的。

sentences.en: That was an appropriate response for what was happening at that moment.
sentences.zh: 那是对当时正在发生的事情的恰当反应。

sentences.en: It was so unreal.
sentences.zh: 太不真实了。

sentences.en: And you have described yourself as a religious person.
sentences.zh: 你曾把自己描述为一个有宗教信仰的人。

sentences.en: And so I wonder, did you have a singularly spiritual experience in those moments?
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，在那些时刻，你是否有过独特的灵性体验？

sentences.en: The whole thing.
sentences.zh: 整个经历。

sentences.en: The entire mission, to me, was about God's glory.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，整个任务都关乎上帝的荣耀。

sentences.en: I think at any point in the mission, you could go, look at that.
sentences.zh: 我想在任务的任何阶段，你都会感叹，看那个。

sentences.en: That's kind of amazing.
sentences.zh: 那真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: And we did not build that.
sentences.zh: 那可不是我们建造的。

sentences.en: The amazing spacecraft we were in that we built that allowed us to go do it, but it was like we're next to the moon, which dwarfs us.
sentences.zh: 我们建造了让我们能够去那里的神奇飞船，但感觉就像我们挨着月球，它把我们衬托得无比渺小。

sentences.en: And like, we didn't do that, right?
sentences.zh: 就像，那可不是我们造的，对吧？

sentences.en: That's just happened over billions of years.
sentences.zh: 那是经过数十亿年自然形成的。

sentences.en: It's quite an amazing perspective to have.
sentences.zh: 拥有这种视角是相当奇妙的。

sentences.en: All of that is very beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都非常美好。

sentences.en: But we did get one question that I think embodies a little bit of the skepticism that some people have about the cost-benefit analysis of space travel.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实收到过一个问题，我认为它多少体现了某些人对太空旅行成本效益分析的质疑。

sentences.en: So here is Isaac from Arlington, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 所以这里是来自弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿的艾萨克。

sentences.en: Hello, I'm 13.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我13岁。

sentences.en: I'm a normal listener of The Daily, and I just want to know why is it important that
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》的忠实听众，我只想知道为什么

sentences.en: we are spending billions and billions of dollars on something rather than we're just looking at it.
sentences.zh: 我们要花成百上千亿美元去做一些只是看着它的事情。

sentences.en: I believe he said, why are we spending the money when we're not even landing on the moon?
sentences.zh: 我想他说的是，既然我们甚至没有在月球着陆，为什么还要花钱？

sentences.en: We are just looking at it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在看着它。

sentences.en: Jeremy, do you have a thought?
sentences.zh: 杰里米，你有什么想法吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: First of all, Isaac, I think it's a really important question to ask because we have a lot of problems here on the planet that we need to tackle.
sentences.zh: 首先，艾萨克，我认为这是一个非常重要的问题，因为我们在地球上有很多需要解决的问题。

sentences.en: And we are investing a lot of money in space exploration, but I do see it from a different perspective.
sentences.zh: 我们在太空探索上投入了大量资金，但我从不同的角度来看待它。

sentences.en: I see the genius that we bring together under the focus of a common goal and the solutions that people create that allow us to go out into deep space do benefit us here
sentences.zh: 我认为，在共同目标的凝聚下汇聚的天才，以及人们为进入深空而创造的解决方案，确实对我们在地球上的生活大有裨益。

sentences.en: on the planet.
sentences.zh: 在这个星球上。

sentences.en: And I think if we didn't have that push of exploration, we would miss out on these extraordinary innovations that only come together
sentences.zh: 我想如果我们没有探索的推动力，我们就会错过那些非凡的创新，而这些创新只有在

sentences.en: when it's not one mind, but when it's a thousand minds trying to solve a problem together.
sentences.zh: 不是一个人，而是成千上万的人试图一起解决一个问题时才会诞生。

sentences.en: Well, we got questions that were about things that were much less serious and much more tangible than that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们收到的有些问题内容没那么严肃，比这要切实得多。

sentences.en: The kids were actually obsessed with every single part of your trip.
sentences.zh: 孩子们简直对你们旅行的每一个部分都着迷。

sentences.en: I wondered if the astronaut played any games on the spaceship, like tag or something, kept still floating.
sentences.zh: 我想知道宇航员在飞船上是否玩过什么游戏，比如抓人游戏之类的，在失重状态下飘来飘去。

sentences.en: And I was wondering if your ears popped.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们的耳朵会塞住吗。

sentences.en: How do you shower and clean yourself?
sentences.zh: 你们如何洗澡和清洁自己？

sentences.en: Because at first that would smell really bad for four people in space.
sentences.zh: 因为一开始四个在太空的人味道会很难闻。

sentences.en: They wanted to know what space smelled like.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道太空是什么闻起来的。

sentences.en: What happens if the astronauts turn out of fire?

sentences.zh: 他们对你们吃的东西有很多疑问。

sentences.zh: 我向宇航员提的问题是，太空里的食物跟你们在地球家里的食物一样好吃吗？

sentences.en: Quick question for the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 问宇航员一个简短的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have pizza parties up there?
sentences.zh: 他们在上面会开披萨派对吗？

sentences.en: How do you guys get food if there's no restaurant?
sentences.zh: 如果那里没有餐厅，你们是怎么弄到食物的？

sentences.en: What do you eat in space for dessert?
sentences.zh: 你们在太空中吃什么甜点？

sentences.zh: 你们能在太空中喝苏打水吗？

sentences.en: I'll take first stab at this.
sentences.zh: 我来打个头阵回答这个问题。

sentences.en: First, yes, we have broccoli, and it's actually delicious.
sentences.zh: 首先，是的，我们有西兰花，而且其实非常好吃。

sentences.en: Broccoli au gratin, one of my favorite things to eat.
sentences.zh: 奶油焗西兰花，我最喜欢吃的东西之一。

sentences.en: You're just saying that.
sentences.zh: 你只是说说而已。

sentences.zh: 你这么说只是因为你在跟孩子们的父母对话。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.zh: 里面有奶酪，但你只需要加一点点水然后加热就行。

sentences.en: It was very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好吃。

sentences.en: The food is magnificent.
sentences.zh: 这里的食物太棒了。

sentences.zh: 我们有玉米饼。

sentences.en: You can put brisket on a tortilla.
sentences.zh: 你可以在玉米饼上放牛胸肉。

sentences.en: We have chicken and beans, broccoli, spicy green beans is another favorite.
sentences.zh: 我们有鸡肉和豆子、西兰花，辣味青豆是另一个最爱。

sentences.en: What were some of your favorites?
sentences.zh: 你们有哪些最喜欢的？

sentences.en: Beets.
sentences.zh: 甜菜根。

sentences.en: Kale salad.
sentences.zh: 羽衣甘蓝沙拉。

sentences.en: Kale salad.
sentences.zh: 羽衣甘蓝沙拉。

sentences.en: And I wanted to bring in tortillas because, Jeremy, on the first day, I don't know if you invented it, but you may have seen we had Nutella.
sentences.zh: 我想带玉米饼是因为，杰瑞米，在第一天时，我不知道是不是你发明的，但你可能见过我们有能多益巧克力酱。

sentences.en: And taking Nutella and spreading it on a tortilla and then folding that in half, it almost made like a chocolate crepe.
sentences.zh: 把能多益抹在玉米饼上，然后对折，几乎就像做了一个巧克力可丽饼。

sentences.en: And Jeremy was just distributing those around the cabin.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞米当时就在舱里把这些分发给大家。

sentences.en: And they were a great dessert.
sentences.zh: 它们是非常棒的甜点。

sentences.en: Did any of that stuff spill?
sentences.zh: 那些东西有洒出来吗？

sentences.en: Like, did you have a moment where, like, the tortilla had a bend in it?
sentences.zh: 比如说，有没有遇到过玉米饼折弯的情况？

sentences.en: Constantly.
sentences.zh: 经常发生。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: I like to say that, you know, we shared a lot of meals.
sentences.zh: 我常说，你知道，我们一起吃过很多饭。

sentences.en: Sometimes it was on purpose.
sentences.zh: 有时是故意的。

sentences.en: And so, you know, pieces of things would fly by and you make sure it's food, but then you just enjoy what your crewmates eat.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，有些东西的碎片会飞过，你要确认那是食物，然后去享受你的机组队友吃的东西。

sentences.en: Make sure it's food.
sentences.zh: 确认那是食物。

sentences.en: Make sure it's food.
sentences.zh: 确认那是食物。

sentences.en: One of the coolest moments on that first day up there, I had some oatmeal and I didn't put quite enough water in it to rehydrate it.
sentences.zh: 在上面那第一天最酷的时刻之一，我吃了一些燕麦片，我没有加足够的水来让它复水。

sentences.en: And so when I opened it, there was crumbs of oatmeal that just started floating out.
sentences.zh: 所以当我打开它时，燕麦片的碎屑就开始飘出来。

sentences.en: And I don't mean like two crumbs.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是两块碎屑。

sentences.zh: 我是说大约有一万块燕麦片碎屑。

sentences.en: And I was very embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 当时我非常尴尬。

sentences.en: You know, I've flown in space before.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我以前飞过太空。

sentences.en: I shouldn't be making these mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我不应该犯这种错误。

sentences.en: And instead of being annoyed, Victor just floats over and goes, oh, this is my favorite game.
sentences.zh: 但维克托不仅没有生气，反而飘过来说，哦，这是我最喜欢的游戏。

sentences.en: It just starts eating them all out of it.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始把它们全吃掉。

sentences.en: Out of the floating area around me.
sentences.zh: 从我周围漂浮的区域。

sentences.en: It was really great.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: I think there's actually a Simpsons episode where that exactly happened.
sentences.zh: 我想《辛普森一家》里其实有一集就发生过完全一样的事。

sentences.en: With the potato chips.
sentences.zh: 带着薯片的那集。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Wait, so, okay, we did get a question about soda in space.
sentences.zh: 等等，所以，好吧，我们确实收到了关于太空中苏打水的问题。

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你们是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Soda, I haven't seen it happen successfully.
sentences.zh: 苏打水，我还没见过谁成功过。

sentences.en: I think there have been attempts.
sentences.zh: 我想曾有人尝试过。

sentences.en: But for many astronauts, that's something that they crave when they get back.
sentences.zh: 但对许多宇航员来说，那是他们返回后非常渴望的东西。

sentences.en: Something bubbly.
sentences.zh: 带气泡的东西。

sentences.en: What's the problem with carbonated beverages?
sentences.zh: 碳酸饮料的问题出在哪里？

sentences.en: We tried, when I was on Space Station, we did try to drink carbonated beverages.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试过，我在空间站时，确实尝试过喝碳酸饮料。

sentences.en: is some of my Russian crewmates had a soda bottle.
sentences.zh: 我的一些俄罗斯机组队友有一个苏打水瓶。

sentences.en: And we couldn't even open the cap because the bubbles do not go to the top.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至无法打开瓶盖，因为气泡不会往上跑。

sentences.en: They're just distributed throughout the entire thing.
sentences.zh: 它们只是分布在整个液体中。

sentences.en: And anytime we would twist the cap a little bit, it would start to spray out, like if you shook up a can.
sentences.zh: 只要我们稍微拧一下瓶盖，它就会喷出来，就像你摇晃过易拉罐一样。

sentences.en: And so we would twist the cap and just try to suck it off that cap.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能拧一点瓶盖，然后试着从瓶盖上把液体吮吸下来。

sentences.en: And we eventually gave up.
sentences.zh: 我们最终放弃了。

sentences.en: That sounds like the worst way to drink a Sprite.
sentences.zh: 听起来这是喝雪碧最糟糕的方式。

sentences.en: So our next question is from Leonardo in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一个问题来自纽约市的莱昂纳多。

sentences.en: It is about another aspect of daily life.
sentences.zh: 这是关于日常生活的一个方面。

sentences.en: My big question for the Artemis 2 crew is
sentences.zh: 我对阿耳忒弥斯2号乘组的重大问题是

sentences.en: What does it feel like to sleep upside down in space when there is no gravity?
sentences.zh: 当没有重力时，在太空中倒着睡觉是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Also, is there gravity in your dreams?
sentences.zh: 还有，你们的梦里有重力吗？

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I want to be an astrophysicist when I grow up.
sentences.zh: 我长大了想成为一名天体物理学家。

sentences.en: Love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: I think one of the great things about being in weightlessness is there is no upside down.
sentences.zh: 我认为处于失重状态最棒的一点就是没有上下之分。

sentences.en: There is no upside down.
sentences.zh: 没有上下之分。

sentences.en: We are just thinking that through, meaning that any side could be right side up.
sentences.zh: 我们正在深入思考这一点，意思是任何一边都可以是正上方。

sentences.en: It all feels the same.
sentences.zh: 感觉都一样。

sentences.en: It's all convention.
sentences.zh: 这全都是习惯。

sentences.en: What do you call the floor and what do you call the ceiling?
sentences.zh: 你把什么叫地板，又把什么叫天花板？

sentences.en: It could be anything.
sentences.zh: 什么都可以。

sentences.en: Wow, you just blew my mind.
sentences.zh: 哇，你把我震撼到了。

sentences.en: Everyone listening, their mind just got blown in that moment thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 每一个在听的人，在想到这一点时都会感到大受震撼。

sentences.en: Did you have to strap yourself in in some way?
sentences.zh: 你们得用某种方式把自己绑起来吗？

sentences.en: And did anybody ever bump into anybody else in their sleep?
sentences.zh: 有没有人在睡觉时撞到过别人？

sentences.en: I'm sorry, Jeremy.
sentences.zh: 对不起，杰瑞米。

sentences.en: It was you?
sentences.zh: 是你吗？

sentences.en: He just said yes.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚说是。

sentences.en: No, it was me.
sentences.zh: 不，是我。

sentences.en: Well, we kind of slept almost as if we were in bunk beds.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们睡觉的样子几乎就像睡在双层床上。

sentences.en: So like two this way, two this way, but in opposite directions.
sentences.zh: 两个这样，两个那样，但方向相反。

sentences.en: And I ended up sort of in this middle space with Reed and Victor underneath me.
sentences.zh: 我最后不知怎么睡在了中间的空间里，里德和维克托在我下方。

sentences.en: But at one point, I made the mistake of saying, I kind of like how, like, I float around and I move around.
sentences.zh: 但有一次，我犯了个错误，说我有点喜欢自己飘来飘去、动来动去的感觉。

sentences.en: And so once I said that, then Reed would just kick me and I would let him float, bounce around for a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦我这么说了，里德就会踢我一下，然后我就由得他飘浮、在周围弹跳一会儿。

sentences.en: And then I would just be drifting off and then I'd get another kick and I'd go for another ride.
sentences.zh: 接着我正要迷迷糊糊睡着，又会挨一脚，然后又去“兜风”了。

sentences.en: The second part of Leonardo's question was, is there gravity in your dreams?
sentences.zh: 莱昂纳多问题的第二部分是，你们的梦里有重力吗？

sentences.en: I think we all dreamed that we were floating at different times.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都曾在不同时间梦见自己在漂浮。

sentences.en: And one really neat thing that happened, I think, to all of us was when we got back and woke up in our beds at home, we all felt like we were floating for a little while.
sentences.zh: 还有一件非常奇妙的事，我想我们所有人都经历过，那就是当我们返回并醒来躺在家里的床上时，我们都觉得自己飘了一会儿。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So you obviously traveled more than a quarter million miles away from people that you love and your home.
sentences.zh: 所以你们显然去到了距离所爱之人和家园超过四分之一百万英里的地方。

sentences.en: And we got a lot of questions from kids about what that distance might have felt like.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了孩子们提出的许多问题，关于那种距离会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: This one is from Aiden.
sentences.zh: 这个问题来自艾登。

sentences.en: He's eight years old, and he lives in Santa Cruz Mountains, California.
sentences.zh: 他八岁，住在加利福尼亚州的圣克鲁斯山脉。

sentences.en: My question is from Reed.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是问里德的。

sentences.en: think of Christina and journey.
sentences.zh: 想想克里斯蒂娜和杰里。

sentences.en: How did you feel when you were that far away from life?
sentences.zh: 当你们距离生命有那么远时，你们是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Was it lonely?
sentences.zh: 会感到孤独吗？

sentences.en: Was it lonely, Reed?
sentences.zh: 会感到孤独吗，里德？

sentences.en: You are flying with great friends.
sentences.zh: 你们是和好朋友一起飞行的。

sentences.en: And so I never really felt lonely.
sentences.zh: 所以我从来没有真正感到孤独。

sentences.en: I would say the one thing that I definitely felt, and I think it's all individual, but I definitely felt some fear.
sentences.zh: 我要说我确实感受到的一点，而且我想这因人而异，但我确实感受到了一些恐惧。

sentences.en: You are so far away and you're trusting this vehicle and ours handled marvelously well.
sentences.zh: 你们离得那么远，而且你们信任这个交通工具，我们的航天器表现得好极了。

sentences.en: But if something went wrong out there, it could be a very tough day.
sentences.zh: 但如果外面出了什么问题，那可能会是非常艰难的一天。

sentences.en: So that to me is always, it was always in the back of my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这种想法总是挥之不去。

sentences.en: I didn't feel lonely at all, but what I did get this new sense of is how everything is sort of distributed in our galaxy.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不觉得孤独，但我获得了一种全新的感悟，那就是一切在我们的星系中是如何分布的。

sentences.en: When you look up in the night sky, every star you see in our night sky is in our galaxy.
sentences.zh: 当你抬头仰望夜空时，你在夜空中看到的每一颗星星都在我们的星系里。

sentences.en: This is one galaxy in the entire universe.
sentences.zh: 这只是整个宇宙中的一个星系。

sentences.en: And we were looking out from our spacecraft and we were just seeing these other stars in our galaxy, but I was seeing them in a three-dimensional space.
sentences.zh: 我们从航天器里向外看，看到的只是我们星系中的这些其他星星，但我是在三维空间中看到它们的。

sentences.en: Like some of them looked closer than others and the earth and the moon and seeing them and just seeing how they're
sentences.zh: 比如有些看起来比别的更近，还有地球和月亮，看到它们，看到它们

sentences.en: juxtaposed have such a hard time explaining it to people but it was very different than I expected
sentences.zh: 并列的样子，我很难向人们解释这一点，但它和我预期的非常不同

sentences.en: and when I see the pictures now I'm like wow those are really beautiful pictures but that's not what I experienced when I saw it.
sentences.zh: 现在当我看到这些照片时，我想，哇，这些照片真的很美，但那不是我看到它们时的体验。

sentences.en: I didn't feel lonely but I felt longing for earth it's all of the people I love and Shakespeare was down there it's everything right and so but then you get out
sentences.zh: 我不觉得孤独，但我对地球充满渴望，那里有我爱的人，莎士比亚也在下面，那里有一切对吧，所以当你去到

sentences.en: there and you go, there's a lot of nothing out there.
sentences.zh: 那里，你会发现，外面是一片虚无。

sentences.en: Space is emptiness.
sentences.zh: 太空是一片空旷。

sentences.en: There is no air.
sentences.zh: 那里没有空气。

sentences.en: There's a lot of nothing.
sentences.zh: 有大量的虚无。

sentences.en: And you go, wow, if all of the things we know of, even this spacecraft that we're hanging out in was built there, it is an infinitesimally small piece of the universe.
sentences.zh: 你会想，哇，如果我们所知的一切，甚至连我们栖息的这个航天器都是在那里建造的，它也只是宇宙中微不足道的一小部分。

sentences.en: But Mary, Jesus, Gandhi, you know, it's all there.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽、耶稣、甘地，你知道，都在那里。

sentences.en: And these folks and their families, it's special, even though it's small.
sentences.zh: 这些人还有他们的家人，这一切都很特别，尽管它很小。

sentences.en: I don't know that this will relate, but If you look at the crescent moon, it's rounded and it stops where the sun goes to shadow.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否有关联，但如果你看新月，它是圆的，在太阳照不到的阴影处戛然而止。

sentences.en: But when you look at a crescent earth, the same thing happens, but the edge of the earth just extends a little bit longer.
sentences.zh: 但当你看着新月形的地球时，同样的事情也会发生，只是地球的边缘稍微延伸了一点。

sentences.en: And if you look at it, you realize the extension right there, this tiny, it's like two little tiny whiskers coming off the edge of earth.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看，你会意识到那个延伸部分，那个微小的部分，就像从地球边缘长出的两根细小的须。

sentences.en: It's the whole atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 那是整个大气层。

sentences.en: It's everything that keeps us alive.
sentences.zh: 那是让我们得以存活的一切。

sentences.en: You just sense
sentences.zh: 你能够感受到

sentences.en: It's such a special little tiny thing right there, that atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 那是多么特殊、多么微小的一小部分啊，那层大气。

sentences.en: You can just tell the moon cannot sustain life, but Earth can.
sentences.zh: 你能看出月球无法维持生命，但地球可以。

sentences.en: And when you put those two things next to each other, the thing that enables us to live here is so tiny, it's impossible to even rationalize in your mind.
sentences.zh: 当你把这两者放在一起时，那个让我们能够在这里生存的东西是如此微小，以至于你脑海中甚至无法将其合理化。

sentences.zh: 我们要休息一下。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《拼字蜂》和《字母宝盒》游戏。

sentences.zh: 因此，我们想播放大家围绕这个话题提出的极少数几个问题。

sentences.en: My name's Alex.
sentences.zh: 我叫亚历克斯。

sentences.en: I'm pouring three quarters.
sentences.zh: 我正在倒四分之三杯。

sentences.en: And how do they poop or pee in space?
sentences.zh: 他们在太空中是怎么大号或小号的？

sentences.en: How do they go potty in space?
sentences.zh: 他们在太空里怎么上厕所？

sentences.en: How do you go to the bathroom in space?
sentences.zh: 你在太空中怎么上厕所？

sentences.en: the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 宇航员们。

sentences.en: What is it like to go to the bathroom in space?
sentences.zh: 在太空上厕所是什么感觉？

sentences.en: And you guys have any privacy.
sentences.zh: 你们有什么隐私吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: Oh, poop.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Who farts the most in space?
sentences.zh: 太空里谁放屁最多？

sentences.en: Does the poop go up or down?
sentences.zh: 大便是往上飘还是往下掉？

sentences.en: And where does it go?
sentences.zh: 它最后去哪了？

sentences.en: Did you poop in space and did it float?
sentences.zh: 你在太空里大便过吗？它会飘起来吗？

sentences.en: I was wondering what you did while your toilet was broken on the spaceship.
sentences.zh: 我想知道飞船厕所坏了的时候你们是怎么对付的。

sentences.en: Where do you float?
sentences.zh: 你们都飘在哪？

sentences.en: Where do you go, poo-poo?
sentences.zh: 你上哪儿去拉臭臭？

sentences.en: Okay, Artemis crew, the children have spoken.
sentences.zh: 好了，阿尔忒弥斯乘组，孩子们发话了。

sentences.en: Children need to know.
sentences.zh: 孩子们需要知道答案。

sentences.en: They demand answers.
sentences.zh: 他们要求得到答案。

sentences.en: How do you have a bowel movement in space?
sentences.zh: 你在太空中怎么排便？

sentences.en: What part of the toilet broke?
sentences.zh: 厕所的哪个部件坏了？

sentences.en: And what did you do when it did?
sentences.zh: 坏了之后你们是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Well, there was a lot of does it go up?
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家问了好多关于它会不会往上飘的问题。

sentences.en: Does it go down?
sentences.zh: 会往下掉吗？

sentences.en: Where does it go?
sentences.zh: 它去哪了？

sentences.en: If it's going up, you have a problem.
sentences.zh: 如果它是往上飘的，那你就麻烦了。

sentences.en: And you did something wrong.
sentences.zh: 说明你做错了什么。

sentences.en: Because you're right, we don't have gravity to naturally bring all the things where they need to go.
sentences.zh: 因为你说得对，我们没有重力来自然地把所有东西带到它们该去的地方。

sentences.en: But what we do instead is we create an entrainment with kind of like a suction slash fan.
sentences.zh: 但我们采取的做法是，利用类似于抽吸加风扇的装置产生气流。

sentences.en: It's not very, very strong like a vacuum cleaner or anything.
sentences.zh: 它不像吸尘器那样强劲有力。

sentences.en: I was about to say, is it like sitting on a vacuum?
sentences.zh: 我正想说，这就像坐在吸尘器上吗？

sentences.en: Is that what this is?
sentences.zh: 这就是它的原理吗？

sentences.en: It's enough to make everything go where it should go if you do everything right.
sentences.zh: 只要你操作正确，这就足以让所有东西去到它们该去的地方。

sentences.en: So for us, we have the primary toilet, which handles the bowel movements and the urine anomaly.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，我们有主厕所，它负责处理排便和尿液异常。

sentences.en: And then once you urinate into this hose, it gets stored in a tank and then that gets vented to space.
sentences.zh: 一旦你把尿液排进这根软管，它就会被储存在一个罐子里，然后排空到太空中。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The capability to vent it to space clogged, and that failed.
sentences.zh: 将尿液排入太空的功能堵塞了，然后它就故障了。

sentences.en: And so we needed to go to a backup method, which is these just very simple tubes that you can connect to a port on the side of the spacecraft and vent them to space.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要改用备用方法，也就是这些非常简单的管道，你可以将它们连接到航天器侧面的接口上，然后排入太空。

sentences.en: I just assumed you did what we all do, which is use an empty water bottle.
sentences.zh: 我本来以为你们会用我们大家都会用的方法，也就是用一个空矿泉水瓶。

sentences.en: I mean, that's how you do it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大家都是这么干的。

sentences.en: Space water bottle.
sentences.zh: 太空矿泉水瓶。

sentences.en: Okay, it wasn't too far.
sentences.zh: 好吧，离得不远。

sentences.en: Well marked.
sentences.zh: 标记得很清楚。

sentences.en: It was definitely a challenge for us, and we lived that way the whole entire time.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是对我们的一大挑战，我们全程都是那样生活的。

sentences.en: And what's the privacy situation here with all of this?
sentences.zh: 这里处理这些事情的隐私情况怎么样？

sentences.en: For a capsule, pretty good.
sentences.zh: 就太空舱而言，相当不错。

sentences.en: There is a separate toilet area with a door.
sentences.zh: 有一个带门的独立厕所区域。

sentences.en: It's in the floor.
sentences.zh: 它在地板上。

sentences.en: So you get to float in there and you can close it off.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以在里面漂浮，而且你可以把门关上。

sentences.en: It's actually pretty good.
sentences.zh: 其实挺不错的。

sentences.en: It's one private space we had other than putting on headphones, which was a signal that you might want a little privacy.
sentences.zh: 这是我们拥有的唯一一个私人空间，除了戴上耳机，那是一个你可能需要一点隐私的信号。

sentences.en: We could not talk about questions from kids without a question about aliens.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论孩子们的提问时，绝对绕不开关于外星人的问题。

sentences.en: So we have one.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一个这样的问题。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Celine.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫席琳。

sentences.en: I'm eight years old, and I live in California, but I want to live in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我八岁，我住在加利福尼亚州，但我想住在新泽西州。

sentences.en: So I have a question for you guys, the Artemis 2.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个问题要问你们，阿尔忒弥斯2号乘组。

sentences.en: Is there other life out there, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 外面还有别的生命吗，也就是

sentences.en: aliens?
sentences.zh: 外星人？

sentences.en: And did your experience on the dark side of the moon change your answer?
sentences.zh: 你们在月球背面的经历改变了你们的答案吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就这样。

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.zh: 再见！

sentences.en: Aliens, guys?
sentences.zh: 伙计们，有外星人吗？

sentences.en: Who wants to answer?
sentences.zh: 谁想回答？

sentences.en: I mean, I've been to New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我去过新泽西州。

sentences.en: Jeremy?
sentences.zh: 杰里米？

sentences.en: Oh, well, when I think about the universe, and I was talking to you before, every star you see is in our galaxy, the Milky Way.
sentences.zh: 噢，当我想象宇宙时，我之前跟你聊过，你看到的每一颗恒星都在我们的银河系内。

sentences.en: But then we think there's maybe a couple trillion other galaxies out there.
sentences.zh: 但我们认为外面可能还有大约数万亿个其他星系。

sentences.en: So it's pretty hard to fathom that there's not alien life out there.
sentences.zh: 所以很难想象外面没有外星生命。

sentences.en: If you look at the closest neighboring galaxy, which is Andromeda, let's say there's this amazing civilization there.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看离我们最近的邻近星系，也就是仙女座星系，假设那里有一个了不起的文明。

sentences.en: They have the most extraordinary telescopes, and they're looking at Earth right now while we're chatting.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有最非凡的望远镜，而且就在我们聊天的时候，他们正在看着地球。

sentences.en: What do they see?
sentences.zh: 他们看到了什么？

sentences.en: They see us a couple hundred thousand years ago, and so we're not here.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的是几十万年前的我们，所以我们现在并不在那里。

sentences.en: That's our closest neighboring galaxy.
sentences.zh: 那是离我们最近的邻近星系。

sentences.en: So it gives you an idea of how hard it is to look for life in the universe.
sentences.zh: 所以这让你明白在宇宙中寻找生命是多么困难。

sentences.en: It's just really far away, even at the speed of light.
sentences.zh: 即使以光速计算，它也真的是太远了。

sentences.en: As the details about the toilet show, you guys prepared for every single eventuality.
sentences.zh: 正如关于厕所的细节所显示的那样，你们为每一种可能发生的情况都做好了准备。

sentences.en: So I have to ask, did any of your training, Victor, include what to do just in case you encountered an alien?
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不问，维克托，你们的任何训练中是否包含万一遇到外星人该怎么办？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: But the other part of that question, did our experience on the far side of the moon change that?
sentences.zh: 但那个问题的另一部分，我们在月球背面的经历改变了这一点吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: We've looked.
sentences.zh: 我们找过了。

sentences.en: I mean, we have a lot of resources pointed at this dark sky looking for answers, and it's a great question, and I hope it continues to drive us to explore further.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们有大量资源聚焦于这片黑暗的天空寻找答案，这是一个很棒的问题，我希望它能继续推动我们进一步探索。

sentences.en: I just want to point out that no is the answer that somebody who saw an alien but wasn't allowed to talk about it would say.
sentences.zh: 我只想指出，“没有”这个答案正是那些见过外星人却不被允许谈论的人会给出的回答。

sentences.en: You realize if we found alien life out there and we came back and reported on it, NASA would never have a budget issue for the rest of eternity.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，如果我们真的在外面发现了外星生命，并回来作了报告，美国国家航空航天局在永恒的未来里就再也不会有预算问题了。

sentences.en: So trust me.
sentences.zh: 所以相信我。

sentences.en: That is one good argument.
sentences.zh: 这倒是一个很好的论点。

sentences.en: I'm not going to argue with that.
sentences.zh: 我不会反驳这一点。

sentences.en: Also, we tell Reed not to say things all the time, and he doesn't.
sentences.zh: 另外，我们一直都在告诉里德不要说某些事，而他也确实没说。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: We have one more question about your experience while you were actually in space.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个关于你们在太空实际经历的问题。

sentences.en: This is Clara Jones, age nine, of Dallas, Texas.
sentences.zh: 这位是来自得克萨斯州达拉斯的克拉拉·琼斯，九岁。

sentences.en: What was the most beautiful thing you saw?
sentences.zh: 你们见过的最美丽的东西是什么？

sentences.en: What was the most beautiful thing you saw?
sentences.zh: 你们见过的最美丽的东西是什么？

sentences.en: Victor, would you like to start?
sentences.zh: 维克托，你想先说吗？

sentences.en: I'm sorry to be boring on this, but it's the Earth.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉我的回答这么无趣，但它是地球。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It just stood out.
sentences.zh: 它太出众了。

sentences.en: It was so different.
sentences.zh: 它是如此与众不同。

sentences.en: The colors, the shapes, our planet looks alive.
sentences.zh: 那些色彩、那些形状，我们的星球看起来充满生机。

sentences.en: Even though we can't see human structures in boats and roads, it looks alive because the swirls change.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们看不到人类的建筑、船只和道路，但它看起来就像是有生命的，因为气旋在不断变化。

sentences.en: and it just, it demands your attention.
sentences.zh: 而且它就是，它吸引着你的全部注意。

sentences.en: When you see it out the window, you have to stare at it.
sentences.zh: 当你在窗外看到它时，你必须盯着它看。

sentences.en: I think one of the most beautiful moments from this, at least for people watching back home, was the video read where you dedicated the crater to your late wife, Carol.
sentences.zh: 我认为这次任务最美好的时刻之一，至少对国内观看直播的人来说，是里德在视频中把那个环形山献给你已故的妻子卡罗尔。

sentences.en: Would you mind describing that moment and what you were thinking and feeling?
sentences.zh: 你介意描述一下那个时刻以及你当时的想法和感受吗？

sentences.en: Well, thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你这么问。

sentences.en: I mean, that was a special moment for this crew and it was clearly a special moment for everyone watching.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于我们乘组来说这是一个特殊的时刻，对于所有观看的人来说显然也是一个特殊的时刻。

sentences.en: Christina had the idea and Jeremy approached me before we launched and said hey the crew would
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜想出了这个主意，杰里米在发射前找到我说，嘿，乘组想要

sentences.en: like to do this and I said Jeremy that would be it would be an amazing honor for for my family and
sentences.zh: 做这件事，我说杰里米，这对我家人来说将是一个无上的荣誉，

sentences.en: I would love it if you all did that but I cannot do the talking and so Jeremy did and it was
sentences.zh: 如果大家能这么做我会非常高兴，但我无法自己开口说，所以由杰里米代劳了，这让我们所有人都

sentences.en: very emotional for all of us it was I mean I just Jeremy I still can't believe you
sentences.zh: 感慨万千，我的意思是，杰里米，我到现在还是不敢相信你

sentences.en: made it through that.
sentences.zh: 撑过了那一刻。

sentences.en: There's a feature in a really neat place.
sentences.zh: 有一个地貌在一个非常美妙的地方。

sentences.en: I can't believe that thought that you all put into that was very special for me.
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信你们付出的那些心思，这对我和我的家人来说非常特殊。

sentences.en: We will be able to see this from Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们将能够从地球上看到这一点。

sentences.en: And so we lost a loved one.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们失去了至爱之人。

sentences.en: Her name was Carol.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫卡罗尔。

sentences.en: And as we were approaching the moon, even days away from the moon, we could look out and see that crater.
sentences.zh: 当我们接近月球时，甚至在离月球还有几天的时候，我们就能向外望去看到那个环形山。

sentences.en: That's supposed to read the mother of.
sentences.zh: 这里应该是宣读……

sentences.en: And it turned out that both of my daughters were in mission control.
sentences.zh: 结果证明我的两个女儿当时都在任务控制中心。

sentences.en: They were in the viewing room.
sentences.zh: 她们在观景室里。

sentences.en: And that moment, even though it was an honor of my late wife and primarily to my two daughters, but that was the moment that our crew coalesced.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，尽管这是为了纪念我已故的妻子，主要是为了我的两个女儿，但那是我们乘组真正凝聚在一起的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think we were bonded there forever.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在那里紧密相连，直到永远。

sentences.en: How did your daughters react when they first learned that you'd be able to do this for their mom?
sentences.zh: 当你的女儿们第一次得知你将能为她们的妈妈做这件事时，她们作何反应？

sentences.en: We still haven't talked through that, but I know it was, they did not know it was coming.
sentences.zh: 我们还没来得及细聊，但我知道这是，她们事先并不知道会有这一出。

sentences.en: And I know it was, I think for them, I can't think of a more special moment in their lives to
sentences.zh: 我知道这是，我想对她们来说，我简直想不出在她们的生命中还有什么更特别的时刻，

sentences.en: to get to hear those words come down that sounds very beautiful it was you guys have done so many
sentences.zh: 能听到那些话语传下来，听起来非常美好，确实如此，你们回来后做了那么多采访，显然现在正在做这个，而且嗯，你们

sentences.en: interviews since you've gotten back you're obviously doing one right now and um you will
sentences.zh: 在余生中大概都会被问到这次旅行，我想知道你们打算如何铭记

sentences.en: probably get asked about this trip for the rest of your life and i wonder how you plan to hold on
sentences.zh: 这样独特而特殊的经历，杰里米？

sentences.en: to something this singular and special jeremy uh we talked a lot about gratitude and just remembering what a privilege this was.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了很多关于感恩，以及仅仅是记住这是一项多么巨大的特权。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're not doing it that well right now on the planet, but we can at least have the stated goal of trying to get to where we collaborate to lift one another up here.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们现在在这个星球上做得还不够好，但我们至少可以把“努力在这里相互协作、彼此扶持”作为共同的目标。

sentences.en: Victor, I think I heard in an interview that you tried to kind of seal yourself off from the world for a week, just a process.
sentences.zh: 维克托，我想我在一次采访中听说，你试着让自己与世隔绝一个星期左右，只为了消化这些经历。

sentences.en: Can you talk a little about that?
sentences.zh: 能稍微谈谈那个吗？

sentences.en: Two weeks, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实是两个星期。

sentences.en: Two weeks.
sentences.zh: 两个星期。

sentences.en: You managed two weeks.
sentences.zh: 你撑了两个星期。

sentences.en: It ended when we started this trip to, you know, get out and share the news.
sentences.zh: 它在我们开始这次出来分享消息的行程时结束了。

sentences.en: And I think that for me, that two weeks was nice.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对我来说，那两个星期很美好。

sentences.en: It was medical checks and reconditioning, working out.
sentences.zh: 那是医疗检查、身体调理和锻炼的时间。

sentences.en: And it's also given me time to just get ready for this, to just think about it and be very intentional as we transition to being more in the public and
sentences.zh: 这也给了我时间为这一切做好准备，去思考它，并在我们过渡到更多地出现在公众面前时保持高度的专注，

sentences.en: to connect it to the previous question you asked.
sentences.zh: 并将它与你之前提出的问题联系起来。

sentences.en: I've actually decided it's not as a person who gets to kind of be an ambassador of the cosmos, right?
sentences.zh: 我其实已经决定，作为有机会成为宇宙大使的人，不能只局限于此，对吧？

sentences.en: Like that's a crazy job title to be an astronaut.
sentences.zh: 就像宇航员是一个疯狂的头衔一样。

sentences.en: I don't want to hold on to it.
sentences.zh: 我不想紧抓着它不放。

sentences.en: I was there and I can't, I will never be able to put words to what we actually saw, felt there.
sentences.zh: 我曾经去过那里，但我无法，我也永远无法用言语来表达我们在那里实际看到和感受到的东西。

sentences.en: I'll try, but really I want to give it away.
sentences.zh: 我会去尝试，但实际上我想把它传递出去。

sentences.en: I want to give it away technically to the next crew, and I want to give it away socially and culturally to people who have made it possible.
sentences.zh: 我想从技术上把它传递给下一代乘组，我也想从社会和文化的层面上把它传递给所有使这一切成为可能的人们。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢。

sentences.en: Again, gratitude for doing this, but it's not mine to hold on to.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你们完成这次任务，但这不属于我个人所有。

sentences.en: I think one of the astounding things about your trip was just how much it brought people together.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们这次旅行最了不起的事情之一，就是它极大地凝聚了人心。

sentences.en: You're talking about your crew back home, but also you guys have said you wanted to do something that was really unifying for people watching.
sentences.zh: 你们不仅是在说留守后方的乘组，而且你们也说过，希望做一些真正能将观众凝聚在一起的事。

sentences.en: And now that you've had a chance to come back and reflect, we want to ask one more question from a kid that kind of gets at what your takeaway might have been.
sentences.zh: 既然你们现在已经回来并有了时间反思，我们想问一个来自小朋友的问题，它或许能说明你们最大的感悟是什么。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Amalia.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫阿马利亚。

sentences.en: I'm 11 and a half years old and I'm calling from Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我今年十一岁半，我从洛杉矶打来电话。

sentences.en: My question is, when you saw the whole earth from far away, did it make you think differently about what really matters in life, like what people should
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，当你从远处看到整个地球时，它有没有让你对生命中真正重要的事情产生不同的看法，比如人们应该

sentences.en: care about or how we should treat each other?
sentences.zh: 关心的事，或者我们应该如何对待彼此？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's such a deep question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常深刻的问题。

sentences.en: There's so many, there's so many things that I want to say.
sentences.zh: 有太多，有太多我想说的话了。

sentences.en: I guess the thing that I would relate to that is you see the purity of earth and you can sit there and wonder why we can't get along and why we have
sentences.zh: 我想我能联系到的一点是，你看到了地球的纯净，你会坐在那里纳闷，为什么我们不能和睦相处，为什么我们会有

sentences.en: differences i would also say that that maybe those differences are what makes us great sometimes it
sentences.zh: 分歧。我也想说，也许正是这些分歧有时造就了我们的伟大，它

sentences.en: lets us explore different avenues if we were all the same i don't think we would do what we do
sentences.zh: 让我们去探索不同的途径。如果我们完全一样，我想我们不会做我们所做的事。

sentences.en: well we've we've talked about joy yeah i think it really said in our hearts that you know our
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们谈到了快乐，是的，我觉得它确实铭刻在我们的心中，你知道的，我们

sentences.en: purpose here on this planet is joy and lifting one another up and i don't think that's new but But I think it's certainly reinforced that for us.
sentences.zh: 在这个星球上的目的就是快乐以及彼此扶持，我觉得这并不新鲜，但我想它确实强化了我们对这一点的认识。

sentences.en: I have one last question for you guys, which is, I think most people believe you when you say that nobody could understand this experience.
sentences.zh: 我有一个最后的问题想问各位，那就是，我觉得当你们说没有人能真正理解这种经历时，大多数人都是相信的。

sentences.en: You had something wonderful happen, and you're going to carry it with you for the rest of your lives, and we're just not going to get it.
sentences.zh: 你们经历了一件美妙的事，并且它将伴随你们的余生，而我们是绝对无法感同身受的。

sentences.en: But I also wonder whether being up there with no life gave you a renewed appreciation or
sentences.zh: 但我也在想，身处那片毫无生命的太空中，是否让你们对地球上这种在我看来

sentences.en: wonder for what I think is sort of the unlikely scenario of life down on Earth and just all the things that had to come together for us to even be here right now?
sentences.zh: 几乎不大可能存在的生命奇迹，以及为了让我们此刻能够存在而必须汇聚在一起的种种事物，产生了崭新的感激与惊叹？

sentences.en: One thousand percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之一千。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: That was one of the biggest takeaways.
sentences.zh: 那是最大的感悟之一。

sentences.en: Because when you look out and you see the Earth, tiny Earth, and you mostly see Blackness around it, you recognize what a completely
sentences.zh: 因为当你向外望去，看到地球——那个微小的地球，而它周围大多是一片漆黑时，你会意识到这是一个多么完全

sentences.en: unlikely scenario this is and how precious it is.
sentences.zh: 不可能发生的奇迹，又是多么的珍贵。

sentences.en: There is some such thing as a global scale and we have a choice as to what we do with that.
sentences.zh: 全球视野确实存在，而我们对于如何运用它拥有选择权。

sentences.en: I think what I sort of wanted to end with is just a gratitude to people who paid attention to the mission.
sentences.zh: 我想最后表达的，是对那些关注这项任务的人们的感激之情。

sentences.en: We look a lot and pay attention at the negative right now and the things that are different and how they're wrong, but you can also look at the things that are different between us
sentences.zh: 我们现在花了很多时间和精力去关注负面的事物，关注那些彼此不同以及错误的地方，但你也可以去关注我们彼此之间

sentences.en: and how that's right and how that's an asset.
sentences.zh: 不同的地方，以及这如何是正确的是一种优势。

sentences.en: And so what I have a renewed sense for is that people are willing to spend energy and pay attention to the positive things, and therefore we have a choice of where
sentences.zh: 因此，我获得的一种全新感悟是，人们愿意花费精力去关注积极的事物，因此我们有权选择将

sentences.en: we put our energy and our attention.
sentences.zh: 精力和注意力放在哪里。

sentences.en: Our world, our choice.
sentences.zh: 我们的世界，我们的选择。

sentences.en: Thank you all so much for spending this much time with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家花这么多时间陪我们聊天。

sentences.en: I get my last word.
sentences.zh: 我要说最后一句。

sentences.en: Oh, sorry.
sentences.zh: 哦，抱歉。

sentences.en: I was looking.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚在看……

sentences.en: I thought you were nodding like you were missing the last thing that
sentences.zh: 我还以为你在点头，好像你要错过最后那句

sentences.en: This is the most profound comments you could ever hear.
sentences.zh: 这是你能听到最深刻的评论了。

sentences.en: So if there's kids listening, I want to give homework.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有小朋友在听，我想布置一项家庭作业。

sentences.en: You absolutely can.
sentences.zh: 你们当然可以这样做。

sentences.en: My homework would be the next time you see something in bloom or something growing out of the ground, just stop for a second and look at it and just be impressed by it.
sentences.zh: 我的家庭作业是，下次当你看到盛开的鲜花或破土而出的植物时，请停下脚步看上一秒，并为之赞叹。

sentences.en: Because sometimes you have to leave and look back and then come back to realize the simplest little thing can be the most impressive thing you've seen all week.
sentences.zh: 因为有时你必须离开，回望过去，然后再回来，才会意识到最简单的小事也可能是你一星期以来见过的最震撼的事。

sentences.en: Crew of Artemis II, it has been such a pleasure, and congratulations.
sentences.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯2号乘组，能与你们交流非常荣幸，恭喜你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Officials at the Food and Drug Administration have blocked publication of several studies supporting the safety of widely used vaccines against COVID-19 and shingles.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局的官员阻止了几项研究的发表，这些研究支持广泛使用的COVID-19和带状疱疹疫苗的安全性。

sentences.en: The latest step by an administration that has tried to limit access to vaccines and promoted information that casts doubt on their safety.
sentences.zh: 这是一个试图限制获取疫苗并传播对其安全性产生怀疑的信息的政府所采取的最新举措。

sentences.en: The studies were conducted by scientists at the FDA and cost millions of dollars in public funds.
sentences.zh: 这些研究由FDA的科学家进行，花费了数百万美元的公共资金。

sentences.en: Researchers found serious side effects to the COVID-19 and shingles vaccines to be very rare.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，COVID-19和带状疱疹疫苗的严重副作用非常罕见。

sentences.en: And Senate Republicans have inserted a billion dollars for security enhancements for President Trump's new ballroom
sentences.zh: 参议院共和党人将为特朗普总统的新宴会厅提供十亿美元的安全升级资金，塞进

sentences.en: into the immigration enforcement funding bill they hope to rush through Congress this month.
sentences.zh: 了他们希望本月在国会通过的移民执法拨款法案中。

sentences.en: Democrats pounced on the proposal, signaling that they intended to make the ballroom a centerpiece of their opposition to the measure and their election year message
sentences.zh: 民主党人猛烈抨击了这一提议，暗示他们打算将这个宴会厅作为反对该法案的核心议题，并以此传达他们的选举年信息，即

sentences.en: that the president and his party were not meeting voters' needs.
sentences.zh: 总统及其政党没有满足选民的需求。

sentences.zh: 总统此前曾坚称，翻修费用将通过私人捐款筹集，而提议的新宴会厅目前正在法庭上面临法律挑战。
